stages.text:
Wake up slow
kind: ad
style: Live-action; a still close-up, warm dawn light, quiet natural sound, and a simple cream end card.
For the first three seconds, the camera holds close on the Plaid Mug on the wooden table in the kitchen. Dawn light enters through the window, warming the wooden table. Steam rises from hot brewed coffee in the Plaid Mug, curling above the ceramic rim. The Plaid Mug’s handle and plaid pattern remain visible. There is no music or speech.

Over the next four seconds, Mara’s hand enters beside the Plaid Mug. Mara’s hand closes around the Plaid Mug’s handle. A faint brush against ceramic is audible. The Plaid Mug lifts slowly from the wooden table, with steam still rising. The camera stays still as the Plaid Mug rises toward the upper edge of the frame.

For the final three seconds, the image cuts to a plain cream background. The Cabin Coffee Company logo appears: an irregular burgundy five-point star beside bold, condensed black lettering, CABIN above COFFEE CO. Beneath the Cabin Coffee Company logo, the final words appear: Wake up slow
stages.note: research: Cabin Coffee 10-second ad research. Working identification: Cabin Coffee Company, the Iowa-founded roaster and café franchise. The name is ambiguous: a separate Cabin Coffee operates in Arizona, so confirm the advertiser before using these brand references.

items.prompt: Live-action, warm and quiet, for people who buy specialty coffee. Make one 10-second, 16:9 YouTube ad with natural photographic detail, restrained movement, and an unhurried rhythm. 0–3 s: A locked-off close-up shows a plain ceramic mug with a curved handle resting on a wooden table at dawn. The mug contains dark hot brewed coffee, with delicate steam clearly rising against the softly shaded background. Low, warm dawn light enters from the side, grazing the wood grain and illuminating the steam. Keep the surroundings indistinct, with no identifiable café, landscape, or building. Focus on the mug rim, steam, and tactile tabletop; the background stays softly blurred. Hear only faint morning room tone and a distant bird, gently mixed. 3–7 s: A single relaxed hand enters slowly from the right, curls its fingers naturally around the handle, and lifts the same mug smoothly clear of the table. Its shadow separates from the base as the mug rises; steam continues drifting upward. Keep the camera still and the motion physically natural. Hear a soft fingertip contact and a subtle ceramic release from the wood. No face appears. 7–10 s: Cut to a simple cream end card. Center the exact words 'Cabin Coffee' in medium dark-brown lettering above the exact words 'Wake up slow' in larger dark-brown lettering. Both appear immediately, comfortably inset, and remain perfectly still and legible for all three seconds through the final frame. Let the quiet room tone linger. No other text, no logos, no additional cuts, no music, no speech, and no subtitles.
